title: 0220 - GAUSSIAN-SPLAT FIELD TRIP (research, OFF-BOARD, no RH claim): the owner's 'boom as a Gaussian splat / neural nets / movement in video games' question, executed as a literature pass over the 2024-2025 real-time graphics games splatting literature + a translation into three named G-lane programs - (G-1, PRIORITY) the MIP + ANALYTIC splat field of the weave: measure the 24-adic front/antipode asymmetry as raw bins (ALIASED - what 0216/0218 did) AND as analytic window integrals of a Gaussian-splat field (the Analytic-Splatting ECCV-2024-oral trick); the Mip-Splatting (CVPR-2024) trap says a scale ladder is a ZOOM and the measurement footprint widens with X (typical gap ~ ln X: 14.5 -> 18.4 over 2e6 -> 1e8), so the L1b DEcay (0.073 -> 0.056) may be partly pure MIP-BLUR artifact rather than true LO-law decay; falsifiable: deconvolved asymmetry flat => the bloom is fixed geometry seen through a widening lens (the 0196/0216/0218 'slow bias' gets re-explained); still decays => genuine slow bias, measured cleanly; (G-2) the SPLINE MOTION of the weave (SplineGS/4DGS/ADC-GS CVPR-IJCAI-2025 tricks): the weave statistics (bloom masses, the 12x12 pair matrix, lane biases) as a MOVING splat field vs X, fit with a few cubic-Hermite control points + a rank decomposition of the pair-matrix EVOLUTION (anchor-driven group drifts + local residuals); 'the motive for movement' = how many control points the evolution needs (2 = pure LO slow law; >=3 = an extra degree of freedom); (G-3) the BABY model / NN marriage ('you me and baby makes three' = the REAL data, the PAIR LAW, the LEARNED model): interpolated k-grams k=1..4 + a small hand-rolled numpy GRU (d=16; no torch/sklearn on this box - verified - so the NN is dependency-free and auditable), fit on the first 80% of the tail, held-out per-symbol nats = extrapolated entropy rate H_nn; saturated at the pair level => pair law IS the loom (marriage holds); still improving with context => deep weave, depth measured; the NN is a MEASUREMENT INSTRUMENT (model-capacity ladder), not a proof object; tricks captured (one line each): EWA projection (a 3D Gaussian renders as an exact 2D elliptical Gaussian via J*Sigma*J^T - the math of 'how a blob looks through a window'); tile binning (bin splats into 16x16 px tiles, sort per tile, early alpha termination - why BILLIONS of splats hit 100+ FPS; SplatRenderer/LCC/RetinaGS UE5 plugins stream .ply/.gsd; NVIDIA vk_gaussian_splatting; arXiv 2506.19415 virtual texturing for billion-splat scenes); Analytic-Splatting (ECCV 2024 ORAL: integrate the Gaussian over the pixel AREA analytically with precomputed 1D Gaussian-CDF tables instead of point-sampling the pixel - kills the aliasing ring); Mip-Splatting (CVPR 2024: aliasing across scales = splats smaller than the sample spacing; fix = a 3D smoothing filter constraining the MINIMUM splat size per axis - the scale ladder is not free); SplineGS MOVotion-Adaptive SpLine (CVPR 2025: a moving splat's trajectory = cubic Hermite splines with a few control points, COLMAP-free, real-time); 4DGS (arXiv 2412.20720: 4D primitives with explicit motion + appearance parameters - the movement is DATA); ADC-GS (IJCAI 2025: anchor-driven - groups of splats share a motion anchor, individuals carry local residuals); CTRL-GS cascaded temporal residues (base trajectory + per-frame residuals); densification (vanilla 3DGS: the splat SET is not static - clone/split where error is large, prune where opacity ~0 - refine where hard, drop what's empty); SDF hybrids (3DGSR/SplatSDF ICCV 2024-25: a continuous SDF glued to the discrete splats for exact geometry queries); infrastructure translations noted-not-built: tile binning -> on-demand window queries over the sieve field; virtual texturing -> compact resumable weave checkpoints (splat set + motion spline); densification -> refine the splat field where the entropy residual is large (a 'loom tension localized' map); honesty notes: G-1 could KILL the L1b decay (that's the point - a falsifiable re-explanation, not a rescue); all G programs finite-scale, single-threaded, 4 cores open, reproducible; scripts named loom5_splat_field.py / loom6_spline_motion.py / loom7_nn_marriage.py, run after 0219 lands (it has: see 0219)
body: Owner (0220): 'you me and baby makes three... what if we need neural networks and not markov chains and if we see the boom as more like a gaussian splat. are there any cool programming tricks for gaussian splats in video games that might be a motive for movement in our analysis? let's look online for this! any recent gaussian tricks in graphics or games.' Literature pass (web_search, 4 angles, 2024-2026 sources; full citation list in docs/LOOM-PENROSE-SIDE-QUEST-2026-10-29.md section 'L5 (0220): GAUSSIAN-SPLAT FIELD TRIP'): (1) engine/real-time: SplatRenderer (UE5 plugin, .ply static 3DGS + .gsd animated 4DGS streaming, 2M+ Gaussians 100+ FPS via RenderGraph + compute shaders), LCC 3DGS Unreal plugin (billion-point, production), RetinaGS (UE5 4/5), gsplat-unity (PlayCanvas-style: splats = transparent meshes, one extra sorting pass per camera), ACM SIGGRAPH '25 workshop: mobile/standalone-VR 3DGS optimization, NVIDIA DesignWorks vk_gaussian_splatting (Vulkan sample: the classic tile-binned rasterizer), Virtual Memory for 3DGS (arXiv 2506.19415: virtual texturing for scene scale). (2) dynamic/video: 4DGS (arXiv 2412.20720: native 4D Gaussians, explicit geometry + appearance + motion parameters), 4D-GS (canonical 3D splats + learned deformation field + decoder), SplineGS (CVPR 2025: MOVotion-Adaptive Splines - cubic Hermite control points for continuous splat trajectories), MoSca (CVPR 2025: 4D motion scaffolds from casual monocular video), ADC-GS (IJCAI 2025: anchor-driven deformable + compressed - group motion anchors + individual residuals), CTRL-GS (cascaded temporal residue), HAIF-GS (hierarchical induced flow), GenMOJO / prior-enhanced (object decomposition + generative priors). (3) analytic/alias-free: Analytic-Splatting (ECCV 2024 ORAL: pixel-shading = analytic area integral of the Gaussian, precomputed 1D CDF tables = anti-aliased), Mip-Splatting (CVPR 2024: 3D smoothing filter = minimum splat size per axis + 2D mip filter = alias-free across scales/focal lengths), Volumetrically Consistent 3DGS rasterization (arXiv 2412.03378: analytic transmittance replaces the splatting approximation), SDF hybrids (3DGSR arXiv 2404.00409, SplatSDF ICCV 2025: discretized SDF for relightable assets). Synthesis (the three G programs; each a direct trick -> prime-weave translation): G-1 = Mip + Analytic-Splatting -> the L1b decay test (raw bins vs analytic splat-field integrals; the widening-footprint/zoom trap; could re-explain the 0.073 -> 0.056 'slow bias decay' as sampling blur - the SHARPEST open question the field trip produced; PRIORITY). G-2 = SplineGS/4DGS/ADC-GS -> the weave as a moving splat field vs X; a few control points; rank-decompose the pair-matrix evolution; 'how many control points' = the degree-of-freedom count of the weave's motion (2 = LO slow law; >=3 = new). G-3 = 'the baby' -> the NN marriage (interpolated k-grams k=1..4 + numpy GRU d=16, fit 80% / test 20%, held-out nats = H_nn; the capacity ladder that separates 'pair law is the loom' from 'deep weave'; the arbiter of the 0219 A6/G24 residual's two horns). Environment facts recorded: NO torch, NO sklearn on this box (both import fail) -> the NN must be hand-rolled numpy (chosen) or pip-installed later (torch CPU ~800MB - deferred); the k-gram interpolation is dependency-free and classical (Kneser-Ney/Witten-Bell family) so G-3's skeleton needs nothing external. No RH claim; off-board; 4 cores open; reproducible. Status: 0219 (the pair-law marriage) landed the same turn - SPLIT verdict: lanes MARRIED at 1e7/1e8 (perfect -0.0004), fine gap-class words NOT subsumable (A6 -0.146 35.6SE persistent; G24 -0.130 8.9SE decaying) - G-1 and G-3 are now the two named instruments that adjudicate the 0219 residual.
